title: Winter Storm
description: Package about how the 81st Troop Command help coordinate Indiana National Guards response to the ice storm.  Sound bites include 1st Lt. Muzinat Azeez, Personnel Officer, Joint Task Force 81 and Col. Mark Coors, JTF-81 Commander.  Produced by Sgt. Lorne Neff.  Also available in High Definition.
keywords: Indiana National Guard, Lorne Neff, 81st Troop Command, JTF81, Joint Task Force 81, Muzinat Azeez, Mark Coors, High Definition
